title: The Hours We Keep — border and divider assets
source_pdf: The Hours We Keep with appendix.pdf
method: Original vector path rasterization at 600 DPI. Text, images and annotations were excluded from an intermediate PDF; the original path commands, transforms, stroke widths and colors were preserved. Each export is cropped with at least 2 points of transparent padding. No AI image generation or reinterpretation.
fidelity_note: PNG is losslessly encoded, but these are finite-resolution rasterizations of vector artwork, not recovered original raster files. The intentionally faint border palette and inward fade are unchanged.
deduplication: Translation-normalized geometry identifies three border families in both left/right orientations, two mirrored corners and three divider families. Coordinate rounding to 0.01 points is used only for grouping equivalent translated PDF paths; export pixels use unrounded original PDF commands. Every source occurrence is listed.
